title: Great tour with Christian
text: Christian did a wonderful job explaining everything, especially the four columns and the flag.  He gave great information, was able to answer all our questions, and the walking tour had spectacular views of Barcelona.
author: Patricia_E

title: Off the main tourist hussle and bussle
text: You can discover the wonderful Montjuic with a fantastic view over Barcelona. Another very special tour outside the normal tourist routes. A recommandation if you want to a have a very special trip to Barcelona
author: twil2023

title: Wonderful unique Barcelona experience
text: Christian welcomed us like old friends. We spent a wonderful few hours climbing and learning about the mountain. We visited many places we would not have been able to find ourselves. We were lucky to come on a day when the hidden beer garden was open and stopped for refreshments and some great music. Christian is very knowledgeable about Barcelona and was able to answer all our questions. He kindly provided restaurant recommendations and escorted us to a great strip for pinchos after our tour.
